description: This file defines the ResetPasswordController class responsible for handling password reset requests in the OrangeHRM system. It manages the validation of CSRF tokens, reset codes, and user credentials, and facilitates redirection after password reset operations.

classes.name: ResetPasswordController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling password reset actions, validating CSRF tokens, reset codes, and user credentials, and managing password reset flow.

methods.name: getResetPasswordService
methods.description: Lazy initializer for the ResetPasswordService instance used within this controller.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main method to process password reset requests: validates CSRF token, reset code, user credentials, resets password, and redirects to login page.
